text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower has managed to leave
quite a
mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while still basking in the glory
of our
accomplishments...

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
And now, the announcement you've all
been
waiting for! This year's Best
Sprinter Award goes
to... Nishino Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! And also, for the
trainer who has
always been there to
support Nishino Flower...

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
We have a special award in a brand-new

category—Best Rookie Trainer!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's accomplishments have
garnered
plenty of attention, so it was
only natural for her
to win an award,
but...
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます……！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I never imagined I'd get one, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Congratulations, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Please say a few words for the folks here
and
those watching at home!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Congratulations once again, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!
choice_data_list: フラワーもおめでとう！

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
After the Sprinters Stakes, Zephyr said
something
about the "future coming"...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This must've been what she meant! ♪
Oh, I'm so
thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that wasn't the only thing the future
had in
store for us.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's kick things off for today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower and I begin our training
session
like usual when...

text_block_list.name: New Students
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse us! Would it be okay if we
trained
with you?

text_block_list.name: New Student A
text_block_list.text:
We're new students, and we're hoping
you'll scout
us, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: New Student B
text_block_list.text:
I've watched all of Flower's races! She's
really
incredible!

text_block_list.name: New Student B
text_block_list.text:
With everything she's achieved, there's
no one
else I'd rather entrust my future
to than the
trainer who guided her.

text_block_list.name: New Student C
text_block_list.text:
Same here. I'd love to be trained by you

personally.

text_block_list.name: New Students
text_block_list.text: Please grant our request!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Three years ago, I never could have
imagined this
many students directly
requesting that I train
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Nishino Flower's

accomplishments, of course, so she
should take
priority. I decide to talk with
these new students
again later when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and work with them first,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We can continue our training later! ...I'll
be
waiting in the stands. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Heehee.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You really okay with them butting in like
that?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Sky!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Did you see all that just now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sure did. Looks like your trainer's built
quite a
following, eh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...I couldn't be happier.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
For the longest time, I've been wishing
with all my
heart that new doors would
open in Trainer's
future.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why, seeing all those eager
students...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't help but smile! Teehee!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But doesn't it make you jelly, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Jelly? Umm, sure, I like making jelly!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry, forget it. I guess that whole
concept is
lost on you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess you didn't get forced out
of training
against your will. I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Sky? Did you come over here
because you
were worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now where'd you get a wild idea like
that?
Though there is something I
wanted to say...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's about that flower bed. Don't you
think today's
the day?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After giving the new students some
pointers and
finishing Nishino Flower's
training session, she
leads me to...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've been taking care of it,
actually...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I planted seedlings to mark every race I
competed
in and raised them with great
care. All so that I
could show them to
you someday, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot more flowers blooming
here now
than there were three years
ago!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: 3年前から作ってくれてたのか！？
3年前から作ってくれてたの！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The colorful flowers sway gently in the
breeze.
Red, pink, yellow, orange,
white... They
symbolize all we've been
through so far.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've wanted to show you for so long, but
I just
didn't know when the timing would
be right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I knew today was the day after
realizing what
a remarkable trainer
you've become. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to the hard work we put in
together
that there are so many
blooming flowers here.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
For me, seeing your smile is what makes
me
happiest.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So let's continue to make even more
beautiful
flowers bloom. I know we can
do it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right! Because we've both fully come
into our
own! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now, go ahead and take a better look!
Ask me if
you're curious about any of
them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a bellis perennis... Commonly
known as
a daisy!
choice_data_list: この花はなんていうんだ？
この花はなんていうの？

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Raising it in this flower bed certainly
wasn't easy...
But it bloomed
magnificently! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time slowly flows onward as we share a
quiet
moment. I hope to continue
watching over
Nishino Flower's own
growth...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until she blossoms into the greatest,
most elegant
flower of all.
